Gregory Bateson describes a classic example of the interaction between a mother and her son who had fairly well recovered from an acute schizophrenic episode. Bateson described this interaction as follows: '[The son] was glad to see her [his mother] and impulsively put his arm around her shoulders, whereupon she stiffened. He withdrew his arm and she asked, Don't you love me anymore? He then blushed, and she said, Dear, you must not be so easily embarrassed and afraid of your feelings. The patient was able to stay with her only a few minutes more, and following her departure, he assaulted an aide and was put in the isolation room.' Bateson used this interaction to illustrate which ONE of the following concepts?
